findings.claim: Step 4 requires the same ci_provenance.py thu invocation (or another invocation of it) to produce passed for Run, Checkout and Gate output and NOT_MEASURED: 0. This is stronger than protocol §10.2.2–§10.2.3, which accepts sufficiently identified combined evidence. On the exact current master, thu still reports all 39 Gate jobs not_measured for the PR1 run even after its WD import passes. A separate existing per-step evaluator establishes Gate output, as recorded in PR #1497. Thus the prescribed recovery route cannot complete step 4 on this valid evidence combination and its fallback can ask for a merged-instead-of-landed waiver unnecessarily. This finding concerns the procedure, not the dated landed:false snapshot or a claim that the draft archival PR has completed all M8/Issue bookkeeping.

suggested_fix.how: Keep thu --wd-run for the exact target definition identity and retain every raw not_measured value. Define completion over the combined, independently validated evidence for each of the four checkpoints on the same run/attempt/SHA/jobs. Permit the existing separately measured Gate-output report, with evaluator identity, per-step positive markers, command/rc and log/artifact hashes; reconcile it explicitly with the collector output. The cheapest repair is a procedural clarification; improving the standard collector is a separate, more expensive packet.

Wrong run, wrong head, missing job and removed positive marker must remain rejected. This reviewer probe was run; it does not certify pending M8 bookkeeping or the other38 live logs independently.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Combining evidence can accidentally mix attempts, SHA, jobs or workflows, trust a stale evaluator, or turn skipped/missing evidence into passed.
